name: 16AN Braided Black Nylon Hose / Line (E85 + Race Fuel Safe) - 10ft roll
description:
Founded in 2008, ColorFittings is an industry leader in premium automotive, marine, and aviation plumbing products. 

Whether you’re a professional building a 6-second NHRA bracket car, a perfectionist designing the ultimate engine bay for a SEMA car, or an HPDE enthusiast looking to improve your oil temps, our products are designed for all flavors of motorsports.

ColorFittings Nylon and Stainless-steel Braided AN Hose is universally compatible. Common uses include motor oil, gas, E85, race-fuel, and coolant. For more detail about ColorFittings AN Hose, refer here.

The 16AN diameter Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose operates at a 350PSI threshold, and boasts a 1400PSI burst threshold.

For a hassle-free installation process, we strongly recommend using our Fitting Assembly Tools. 

Our Nylon & Stainless-steel braided AN Hose pairs excellently with our lightweight Hose Separators, which are available in unique gloss-finish colors. 

Want to learn more about how our products apply to your vehicle? Read our handy guide here.
